station_name: Guadalupe Creek at San Jose, Calif.
notes: Sampled table is the monthly summary block under the daily grid. Counted as measurements the monthly Maximum, Minimum and Mean cells: 12 months x 3 = 36 (zeros count). n_variables adds the 12 monthly second-foot-days and 12 monthly run-off in acre-feet values (treated as totals / runoff conversions of the daily table) and the 5 + 5 values of the calendar-year and water-year rows: 36 + 24 + 10 = 70. Rules do not say clearly whether monthly second-foot-days and run-off cells are measurements; if they are, n_measurements = 60. Other location words on page: 100 feet downstream from confluence with Los Gatos Creek, in city of San Jose; altitude about 80 feet. Records available January 1930 to September 1938 (period of record, not used).
